items.title: 康樂廣場外籍男子遇襲受傷延至今日不治 改列謀殺案重案組調查
items.summary: 警方將上星期六在中環發生的一宗傷人案改列為謀殺案。 警方當日晚上近9時接報，指一名男子在康樂廣場對開暈倒。人員趕赴現場，發現一名41歲外籍男子倒臥地上，他頭部受傷，昏迷被送往瑪麗醫院治理。經初步調查後，該名男子懷疑曾被人以拳腳襲擊，施襲者其後逃去。…
items.titleEn: Foreign men attacked and wounded on Conley Square, and the investigation into the murder has been postponed until today
items.summaryEn: The police converted a case of wounded people in the Central Ring on Saturday into a murder. The police reported that a man had collapsed on the corner of Conley Square at around 9pm that evening. People rushed to the scene and found a 41-year-old foreign man lying on the ground with a head injury and a coma, who was taken to the Mary Hospital for treatment. After a preliminary investigation, the man was suspected of having been attacked with a fist and the assailant then fled. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 周生生：系統遭受未經授權存取 部分客戶及員工資料或曾被提取
items.summary: 周生生發出公告指，近日發現系統遭受未經授權存取，本周一首次識別有關事件，部分客戶及員工資料可能曾被提取，仍有待進一步核實。初步調查顯示，受影響系統包括會員系統、官方電子商貿渠道。 集團已著手採取措施遏止所有未經授權存取行為、加強系統安全性，並委聘網絡安全專家展開調查及就適當措施提供建議。…
items.titleEn: The system suffered unauthorized access to some customer and employee data or was extracted
items.summaryEn: In an announcement, the company said it had recently discovered that the system was being accessed without authorization, and that the first identification of the incident on Monday was that some of the customer and employee data may have been extracted, and that further verification is still pending. Initial investigations have shown that the affected systems include member systems, official e-commerce channels. The group has taken steps to stop all unauthorized access, strengthen system security, and hire cybersecurity experts to investigate and advise on appropriate measures. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 崇光百貨會員系統遭未經授權取得部分資料 或影響82萬會員資料
items.summary: 崇光（香港）百貨有限公司表示，本月發現會員系統曾遭未經授權人士取得部分資料。受影響資料主要涉及部分會員號碼、姓名、聯絡電話、電郵及會員積分資料。崇光百貨表示，高度重視事件，已立即展開全面調查及跟進工作，已向相關政府部門通報，並正全力配合調查工作。 崇光百貨對今次事件可能為會員帶來的不便深表歉意，已即時採取多項應變措施，包括提升網絡安全系統監察、異常活動偵測、進行詳細調查及風險評估，以及持續監察系統運作情況，以防止同類事件再次發生。…
items.titleEn: In the past, the company's website has been used to access some of the data or to affect 820,000 members without authorization.
items.summaryEn: Hong Kong-based Shopping Co., Ltd. said it discovered that some of the information on its membership system was obtained this month by unauthorized persons. The data affected mainly included the numbers, names, contact phones, emails and collected data of some members. According to Choong-chang, the incident is of high importance and has promptly launched a comprehensive investigation and follow-up, has been notified to the relevant government departments and is cooperating fully with the investigation. The company apologizes for the inconvenience that this incident may have caused its members, and has taken several immediate action measures, including enhancing surveillance of cybersecurity systems, detecting abnormal activity, conducting detailed investigations and risk assessments, and continuing to monitor the operation of the system to prevent similar incidents from happening again. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: IMC再度擴充香港業務 許正宇：持續推動金融高質量發展
items.summary: 全球領先交易公司IMC Trading在13個月內兩度擴充香港業務，遷入中環國際金融中心二期，辦公室面積近2萬平方呎，相當於原有辦公室近3倍。公司計劃將本地團隊人數增加1倍至逾100人，以支持環球交易業務持續創新及發展。 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇在IMC新辦公室開幕禮上表示，香港將繼續推動金融高質量發展，在香港繼續獲全球交易機構視為首選據點的同時，亦期待擴充後的IMC辦公室成為推動持續創新的平台。…
items.titleEn: IMC expands its Hong Kong business once again
items.summaryEn: Global leader trading company IMC Trading has doubled its Hong Kong operations in 13 months to move into its second phase of the Mid-Circle International Financial Center, with nearly 20,000 square feet of office space, nearly three times the size of its original office. The company plans to double the number of local teams to more than 100 to support continued innovation and growth in global trading operations. At the opening ceremony of IMC's new office, Director of Finance and Treasury, Xu Zheng Yu, said that Hong Kong will continue to drive high-quality financial development while continuing to be considered a prime reference point in the global trading community, and expects the expanded IMC office to become a platform for sustained innovation. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 杏花邨男生疑校內被襲擊教育局要求學校跟進 警調查暫未有人被捕
items.summary: 一名13歲男生，本周二在杏花邨一間學校內懷疑被人用手襲擊，清醒送院檢查。警方經初步調查，案件列作「普通襲擊」跟進，交由東區警區反三合會行動組跟進，暫未有人被捕。 港島杏花邨嶺南中學回覆表示，知悉事件後隨即啟動危機處理機制，展開調查及聯絡涉事學生家長，並於翌日陪同家長報警求助。校方正全力配合警方調查，並與教育局保持緊密聯繫，會為相關學生提供適切支援。…
items.titleEn: The school is being investigated by the Ministry of Education for allegedly being attacked at school and no arrests have been made.
items.summaryEn: A 13-year-old boy who was taken to hospital on Tuesday after being suspected of being attacked by a man at a school in Ammanpalua was taken to a hospital for treatment. The police conducted a preliminary investigation into the case, which was classified as a "general assault", and handed it over to the East District Police Counter-Terrorism Task Force, who have not arrested anyone. A response from the South Amphalaya High School in Hong Kong said that it was immediately after the incident that the crisis management mechanism was launched, investigated and contacted the parents of the students involved, and the next day accompanied the parents to call the police for help. The school is cooperating fully with the police investigation and is in close contact with the Department of Education to provide appropriate support to the students concerned. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: Xi Jinping welcomes family and overseas guests to the summit ahead of Sun's 160th birthday
items.summaryEn: The 160th anniversary of the birth of Mr. Sun Zhengsan was celebrated in Beijing's People's Congress Hall this morning. Chinese Communist Party (CCP) General Secretary, National Chairman, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission Xi Jinping attended the memorial gathering to meet with Mr. Sun's family and foreign guests. A video of the National People's Congress (NPC) broadcast by the Central News Agency showed that the delegates included the National People 's Congress (PNC) Chairman Li Hui, the Executive Conference Chairman Liu Yi, the National Council of Governments (NCO) Chairman Liu Wei, and the National People " s Congress representative from the Port District, Mr. Sun-Shan, Mr. Wang, Mr. Wei-yong, among others. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: A single-shot HPV vaccine replacement program has accumulated more than 74,000 doses, with authorities calling for the vaccination to be completed.
items.summaryEn: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reminded citizens that the government's single-shot human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine replacement program for 2024 is set to expire on December 31. Hong Kong residents who are eligible to receive their first dose of the vaccine under the Supplemental Program should take the time to complete the remainder of the vaccination process so as not to miss the last chance to receive a free vaccination. items.titleEn: New Royal Harbour opens a month after 3.3 million people entered the country
items.summaryEn: After the opening of the new port, which has been open for a month, Shenzhen's main port inspection station said that in the first month, there were more than 3.3 million arrivals and more than 110,000 arrivals per day, more than double the number of arrivals before the port was upgraded. The two sides have recently set up a special desk in several ports for the Asia-Pacific Summit. The head of the Department of Transportation and Logistics, Chen Meibao, said that the information and instructions will be clear and will allow passengers to travel efficiently and directly to the meeting room.
